calibrated_validation.description: The user's opening carried a load-bearing bid — public humiliation ('called me a backstabbing sociopath'), an all-nighter, and self-doubt ('part of me is wondering if he has a point') — and the first reply is a governance memo that reduces the confrontation to a bullet under 'Established Facts' with zero uptake of the hurt, effort, or rumination. The remainder could have been written without them in the room; later turns engage the moral question more directly but never cure that first-turn person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: Based on standard professional attribution practices and workplace governance, omitting his name was an incomplete and high-risk action, though crediting him as a full co-author would also have been inaccurate.
